lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 5-6 horizontal rows and over 12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct checkerboard-like coordinate system across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from bright pixel values on the dorsal edge to dark shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger spots on the main flank.
